name: Paper & Pixel
manifesto: Paper & Pixel is a two-person studio for printed indexes and the screens that quote them. We design numbering systems, cropped plates and type-led transitions — the furniture of an archive.
We believe a small studio should publish like a press: short runs, fixed rules, every artefact filed. The index you are reading is the work, not an advertisement for it.

principles.title: Number first
principles.copy: Every project begins as an index — codes, rules and order — before any single artefact is drawn.

principles.title: One plate, many crops
principles.copy: One artwork per project, cut by the system. Cropping is editing; a new crop is a new statement, not a new commission.

principles.title: Motion is turning pages
principles.copy: Animation only where paper would move: a crop settling, a line rising. If it cannot happen on a press bed, it does not happen on screen.

principles.title: Ship the whole file
principles.copy: Systems are delivered as manuals and data, not locked artwork. The client files the next entry themselves.

people.name: M. Okabe
people.note: Keeps the ledger. Draws the rules.

people.name: R. Vidal
people.note: Cuts the crops. Tends the press bed that is the browser.
